content.body:
The Blen-T is a stand-in for the Beaufort Torpedo Bomber. The pilot can launch the torpedo using the secondary fire key. The torpedo should not be launched above 200 feet or 150 mph.
CREW POSITIONS: 1 Pilot 2 Bombardier 3 Top Gunner
content.brief: TYPE: Torpedo Bomber MAX. SPEED: 418 km/h WEIGHT: 6,810 kg CREW POSITIONS: 3 ARMAMENT: .303 cal Browning LMG (1) .303 cal Vickers LMG (1) Mk XII Torpedo (702 kg) (1)
content.title: Bristol Blenheim Mk IV-T (Torpedo Bomber)
